# iNaturalist Data Summary

```{r}
#| label: read-inat-data
# ---- Raw iNat API data (script L101)
raw_EPT <- read_csv(here(L0_data_dir, "002a_raw_EPT_obs.csv")) |>
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# --- Read raw observation data - Filtered to North America L1 ecoregion Estern Temperature Forests (script L003)
# raw EPT in ETF shapefile
raw_ETF_EPT_sf <- read_sf(here(
  L0_data_dir,
  "003_raw_ETF_EPT_obs_shp",
  "003_raw_ETF_EPT_obs.shp"
))
raw_ETF_EPT_df <- as.data.frame(raw_ETF_EPT_sf)
raw_ETF_EPT <- read_csv(here(L0_data_dir, "002a_raw_EPT_obs.csv")) |>
  semi_join(raw_ETF_EPT_df, by = "id") |> # Only keep EPT obs in the ETF
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE) # Remove dupes

# --- Cleaned observation data (script L004)
clean_ETF_EPT <- read_csv(here(L0_data_dir, "004_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.csv")) |>
  select(id, taxon.name) |>
  left_join(raw_ETF_EPT, by = c("id", "taxon.name")) |> # Only keep EPT obs in the ETF
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE) # Remove dupes

# --- Final observation data
# Final observation data after removing image dupes, missing pics, cant ID observations, etc.
# from my annotation process (script L103)
final_ETF_EPT <- readRDS(here(
  L1_data_dir,
  "103a_ETF_EPT_final_annotated.rds"
)) |>
  left_join(
    read_csv(here(L0_data_dir, "004_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.csv")),
    join_by("observation_id" == "id")
  ) |>
  select(species, life_stage, observation_id, lat, long)


rm(raw_ETF_EPT_sf, raw_ETF_EPT_df)
```

## Dataset observation totals - Table 1

```{r}
#| label: get-num-spp-raw
MakePattern <- function(data) {
  string <- paste0("(^|,|/)", data, "(,|/|$)")
}

raw_EPT_totals <- raw_EPT |>
  # Dates 2000-2025
  filter(between(observed_on_details.year, 2000, 2025)) |>
  # Grab species label
  mutate(
    species = case_when(
      str_to_lower(taxon.name) == EPT[1] |
        str_detect(taxon.ancestry, MakePattern(EPT_id[1])) ~ EPT[1],
      str_to_lower(taxon.name) == EPT[2] |
        str_detect(taxon.ancestry, MakePattern(EPT_id[2])) ~ EPT[2],
      str_to_lower(taxon.name) == EPT[3] |
        str_detect(taxon.ancestry, MakePattern(EPT_id[3])) ~ EPT[3],
      .default = NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(species) |>
  # Summarize # obs, plec, tric
  summarize(num_obs_spp = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(total_obs = sum(num_obs_spp), dataset = "Raw Global EPT")
```

```{r}
#| label: get-num-spp-final-ETF
final_ETF_EPT_totals <- final_ETF_EPT |>
  ### pull out incorrect observation ID
  filter(!observation_id %in% c(8413237, 118536515)) |>
  group_by(species, life_stage) |>
  # Summarize # obs, plec, tric
  summarize(num_obs_stage = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(total_obs = sum(num_obs_stage), dataset = "Final ETF EPT") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  mutate(num_obs_spp = sum(num_obs_stage)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  relocate(num_obs_spp, .after = life_stage)
```


```{r}
#| label: table1-spp-totals
final_ETF_EPT_totals_spp <- final_ETF_EPT_totals |>
  select(-num_obs_stage, -life_stage) |>
  mutate(species = str_to_lower(species))

combined_spp_totals <- bind_rows(
  raw_EPT_totals,
  raw_ETF_EPT_totals,
  clean_ETF_EPT_totals,
  final_ETF_EPT_totals_spp
) |>
  distinct(dataset, species, total_obs, .keep_all = TRUE)

pivoted_spp_totals <- combined_spp_totals |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species,
    values_from = num_obs_spp
  ) |>
  relocate(total_obs, .after = last_col())


ft <- flextable(pivoted_spp_totals) |>
  set_header_labels(
    dataset = "Dataset",
    ephemeroptera = "Ephemeroptera\nObservations",
    plecoptera = "Plecoptera\nObservations",
    trichoptera = "Trichoptera\nObservations",
    total_obs = "Total EPT\nObservations"
  ) |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit() |>
  align(j = c(2, 3), align = "center", part = "all")

doc <- read_docx() |>
  body_add_par("EPT Order-Level Summary", style = "heading 1") |>
  body_add_flextable(value = ft)

print(
  doc,
  target = here(L201_figs_dir, "201_table1_dataset_order_table.docx")
)

# Clean up
rm(
  raw_EPT_totals,
  raw_ETF_EPT_totals,
  clean_ETF_EPT_totals,
  final_ETF_EPT_totals_spp,
  combined_spp_totals,
  pivoted_spp_totals,
  ft,
  doc
)
```



## Final Dataset Summaries

### prep data

```{r}
#| label: read-inat-metadata
# Join in iNat metadata
final_ETF_EPT_metadata <- final_ETF_EPT |>
  ### pull out incorrect observation ID
  filter(!observation_id %in% c(8413237, 118536515)) |>
  select(species, life_stage, observation_id) |>
  left_join(
    # Read in iNat metadata
    read_rds(here(
      L1_data_dir,
      "101a_images_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.rds"
    )),
    join_by(observation_id == id)
  ) |>
  select(
    species,
    life_stage,
    observation_id,
    quality_grade,
    annotations,
    identifications,
    identifications_count,
    user.id
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: prep-research-grade
base_reference <- final_ETF_EPT_metadata |>
  ### pull out incorrect observation ID
  filter(!observation_id %in% c(8413237, 118536515)) |>
  mutate(
    life_stage = case_when(
      life_stage %in% c("Immature", "Eggs") ~ "Immature",
      .default = life_stage
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    species = str_trim(species),
    life_stage = str_to_title(life_stage),
    species = factor(
      species,
      levels = c("Ephemeroptera", "Plecoptera", "Trichoptera")
    ),
    quality_grade = fct_recode(
      quality_grade,
      "Needs ID" = "needs_id",
      "Research" = "research"
    )
  )

ETF_EPT_obs_status <- base_reference |>
  group_by(species, life_stage, quality_grade) |>
  summarize(num_obs_stage_grade = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(species, life_stage) |>
  mutate(num_obs_stage = sum(num_obs_stage_grade)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(species) |>
  mutate(num_obs_spp = sum(num_obs_stage_grade)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    prop = num_obs_stage_grade / sum(num_obs_stage_grade),

    ls_label = paste0(
      life_stage,
      "\n",
      str_trim(format(as.numeric(num_obs_stage), big.mark = ","))
    ),
    taxa_label = paste0(
      species,
      "\n",
      str_trim(format(as.numeric(num_obs_spp), big.mark = ","))
    ),
    grade_label = paste0(
      quality_grade,
      "\n",
      str_trim(format(as.numeric(num_obs_stage_grade), big.mark = ","))
    ),
    ls_fill_key = paste(species, life_stage, sep = " - "),
    grade_fill_key = paste(species, life_stage, quality_grade, sep = " - ")
  ) |>
  arrange(species, life_stage, quality_grade)

species_summary <- base_reference |>
  count(species, name = "num_obs_spp") |>
  mutate(
    prop_species = num_obs_spp / sum(num_obs_spp),
    taxa_label = paste0(
      species,
      "\n",
      str_trim(format(as.numeric(num_obs_spp), big.mark = ","))
    )
  )

lifestage_summary <- base_reference |>
  count(species, life_stage, name = "num_obs_stage") |>
  mutate(
    prop_ls = num_obs_stage / sum(num_obs_stage),
    ls_label = paste0(
      life_stage,
      "\n",
      str_trim(format(as.numeric(num_obs_stage), big.mark = ","))
    ),
    ls_fill_key = paste(species, life_stage, sep = " - ")
  ) |>
  arrange(species, life_stage)

grade_summary <- base_reference |>
  count(species, quality_grade, name = "num_obs_grade") |>
  mutate(
    prop_grade = num_obs_grade / sum(num_obs_grade),
    grade_label = paste0(
      quality_grade,
      "\n",
      str_trim(format(as.numeric(num_obs_grade), big.mark = ","))
    ),
    grade_fill_key = paste(species, quality_grade, sep = " - ")
  ) |>
  arrange(species, quality_grade)
```

### create viz

```{r}
#| label: figure1-rg-sunburst
## Fig 1a - Species + life stage

p_lifestage <- ggplot() +
  # Ring 1: Species (Center)
  geom_bar(
    data = species_summary,
    aes(x = 1, y = prop_species, fill = species),
    stat = "identity",
    width = 1.4,
    position = "stack",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = species_summary,
    aes(x = 0.9, y = prop_species, label = taxa_label, group = species),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 6,
    lineheight = 0.85,
    color = "white",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  # Ring 2: Life Stage (Outer)
  geom_bar(
    data = lifestage_summary,
    aes(x = 2, y = prop_ls, fill = ls_fill_key),
    stat = "identity",
    width = 0.5,
    position = "stack",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = lifestage_summary,
    aes(x = 2, y = prop_ls, label = ls_label, group = ls_fill_key),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 5,
    lineheight = 0.85,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y", clip = "off") +
  xlim(0, 2.6) +
  labs(title = "A. Life Stage") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = -8, face = "bold", size = 24)
  )
p_lifestage

### Fig 1b Species + Quality grade

p_grade <- ggplot() +
  # Ring 1: Species (Center)
  geom_bar(
    data = species_summary,
    aes(x = 1, y = prop_species, fill = species),
    stat = "identity",
    width = 1.4,
    position = "stack",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = species_summary,
    aes(x = 0.9, y = prop_species, label = taxa_label, group = species),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 6,
    lineheight = 0.85,
    color = "white",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  # Ring 2: Quality Grade (Outer)
  geom_bar(
    data = grade_summary,
    aes(x = 2, y = prop_grade, fill = grade_fill_key),
    stat = "identity",
    width = 0.5,
    position = "stack",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = grade_summary,
    aes(x = 2, y = prop_grade, label = grade_label, group = grade_fill_key),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 5,
    lineheight = 0.85,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y", clip = "off") +

  labs(title = "B. Observation Quality") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = -8, face = "bold", size = 24)
```

```{r}
#| label: table2-rg-status
summary_table_data <- ETF_EPT_obs_status |>
  mutate(
    # Percent of total dataset
    pct_total = percent(
      num_obs_stage_grade / sum(num_obs_stage_grade),
      accuracy = 0.1
    ),
    # Percent within each species
    pct_within_spp = percent(num_obs_stage_grade / num_obs_spp, accuracy = 0.1),
    # Format counts with commas
    count_formatted = format(num_obs_stage_grade, big.mark = ",")
  ) |>
  select(
    `Order` = species,
    `Life Stage` = life_stage,
    `Quality Grade` = quality_grade,
    `Observations (N)` = count_formatted,
    `% of Total` = pct_total,
    `% within Order` = pct_within_spp
  )

ft <- flextable(summary_table_data) |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  align(j = 1:3, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  align(j = 4:6, align = "right", part = "all") |>
  autofit() |>
  padding(padding = 6, part = "all")

doc <- read_docx() |>
  body_add_par("EPT Observation Summary Table", style = "heading 1") |>
  body_add_par(
    "Breakdown of observation counts and percentages by order, life stage, and quality grade.",
    style = "Normal"
  ) |>
  body_add_flextable(ft)

# Save Word doc
print(doc, target = here(L201_figs_dir, "201_table2_inat_obs_table.docx"))
```

```{r}
  ## Pull out incorrect observation ID
  filter(!observation_id %in% c(8413237, 118536515)) |>
  ## Remove Research-Grade observations from ETF-EPT-iNat-2025 dataset

  ) |>
```

## viz data

```{r}
#| label: summarize-ETF-gbif-data
## 249,812 gbif records all-time in ETF
nrow(etf_ept_gbif_sf)

## however, only 137,675 records in 21st century in ETF
modern_gbif_sf <- etf_ept_gbif_sf |>
  filter(dplyr::between(
    as.Date(eventDate),
    as.Date("2000-01-01"),
    as.Date("2025-12-31")
  ))
nrow(modern_gbif_sf)
```

```{r}
#| label: prep-hex-data
target_crs <- 5070 # Albers Equal
poly_proj <- st_transform(etf_poly, crs = target_crs)
inat_proj <- st_transform(
  final_ETF_EPT_sf |> select(order = species, geometry),
  crs = target_crs
)
gbif_proj <- st_transform(modern_gbif_sf, crs = target_crs)

# Build hexagonal grid (50 km cells)
hex_grid <- st_make_grid(poly_proj, cellsize = 50000, square = FALSE) |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  rename(geometry = x) |>
  mutate(hex_id = row_number()) |>
  st_filter(poly_proj, .predicate = st_intersects)

# Aggregate counts by hex_id and order
inat_order_counts <- hex_grid |>
  st_join(inat_proj) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(!is.na(order)) |>
  count(hex_id, order, name = "n_inat")

gbif_order_counts <- hex_grid |>
  st_join(gbif_proj) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(!is.na(order)) |>
  count(hex_id, order, name = "n_gbif")

# Merge counts and calculate comparison categories by order
hex_order_comp <- full_join(
  inat_order_counts,
  gbif_order_counts,
  by = c("hex_id", "order")
) |>
  mutate(
    n_inat = coalesce(n_inat, 0L),
    n_gbif = coalesce(n_gbif, 0L),
    total_obs = n_inat + n_gbif,
    log_density = log10(total_obs),
    contribution_type = case_when(
      n_gbif == 0 & n_inat > 0 ~ "iNat Only", # new coverage
      n_inat == 0 & n_gbif > 0 ~ "GBIF Only",
      n_inat > n_gbif ~ "iNat Higher",
      n_inat == n_gbif ~ "Equal Density",
      n_inat < n_gbif ~ "GBIF Higher"
    ),
    contribution_type = factor(
      contribution_type,
      levels = c(
        "iNat Only",
        "iNat Higher",
        "Equal Density",
        "GBIF Higher",
        "GBIF Only"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  # Re-attach spatial geometry from hex_grid
  left_join(hex_grid, by = "hex_id") |>
  st_as_sf()

# clean environment
rm(inat_order_counts, gbif_order_counts, hex_grid, target_crs)
rm(inat_proj, gbif_proj)
```


```{r}
#| label: table3-dataset-map-distr
order_summary <- hex_order_comp |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(order) |>
  summarise(
    # Hex counts by exact category
    hex_new_inat_coverage = sum(
      contribution_type == "iNat Only"
    ),
    hex_gbif_exclusive = sum(contribution_type == "GBIF Only"),
    hex_inat_higher_dense = sum(
      contribution_type == "iNat Higher"
    ),
    hex_gbif_higher_dense = sum(contribution_type == "GBIF Higher"),
    hex_equal_density = sum(contribution_type == "Equal Density"),

    # Combined iNat dominance (New coverage + Higher density)
    hex_total_inat_advantage = hex_new_inat_coverage + hex_inat_higher_dense,

    # Combined GBIF dominance (GBIF Exclusive + Higher Density)
    hex_total_gbif_advantage = hex_gbif_exclusive + hex_gbif_higher_dense,

    # Total sampled hexes for this order
    total_hex_with_data = n(),

    # Percentages
    pct_new_inat_coverage = round(
      (hex_new_inat_coverage / total_hex_with_data) * 100,
      2
    ),
    pct_total_inat_lead = round(
      (hex_total_inat_advantage / total_hex_with_data) * 100,
      2
    ),
    pct_gbif_exclusive = round(
      (hex_gbif_exclusive / total_hex_with_data) * 100,
      2
    ),
    pct_total_gbif_lead = round(
      (hex_total_gbif_advantage / total_hex_with_data) * 100,
      2
    ),

    # Observation totals
    sum_inat_obs = sum(n_inat),
    sum_gbif_obs = sum(n_gbif),
    net_new_inat_obs = sum(pmax(0, n_inat - n_gbif)),

    # Average observations per grid
    mean_inat = round(mean(n_inat[n_inat > 0]), 2),
    mean_gbif = round(mean(n_gbif[n_gbif > 0]), 2),
    sd_inat_obs = round(sd(n_inat), 2),
    sd_gbif_obs = round(sd(n_gbif), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(order_summary, width = 500)

# Save as table 3
order_summary_t <- order_summary |>
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) |>
  pivot_longer(-order, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "value") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = order, values_from = value)
doc <- read_docx() |>
  body_add_flextable(autofit(flextable(order_summary_t)))

print(doc, target = here(L201_figs_dir, "201_table3_dataset_map_distr.docx"))
```

```{r}
#| label: create-hex-map
# Set map limits
bbox <- st_bbox(poly_proj)
x_range <- bbox["xmax"] - bbox["xmin"]
y_range <- bbox["ymax"] - bbox["ymin"]

xlim_padded <- c(
  bbox["xmin"] - (x_range * 0.03),
  bbox["xmax"] + (x_range * 0.03)
)
ylim_padded <- c(
  bbox["ymin"] - (y_range * 0.03),
  bbox["ymax"] + (y_range * 0.03)
)

# Pull North America landmass and project
basemap_land <- ne_countries(
  scale = 50,
  continent = "North America",
  returnclass = "sf"
) |>
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(poly_proj))

# Pull US & Canada state/province lines and project
basemap_states <- ne_states(
  country = c("United States of America", "Canada"),
  returnclass = "sf"
) |>
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(poly_proj))


# Build faceted map
figure3 <- ggplot() +
  # North America Landmass
  geom_sf(
    data = basemap_land,
    fill = "#EBEBEB",
    color = NA
  ) +

  # State / Province Boundaries
  geom_sf(
    data = basemap_states,
    fill = NA,
    color = "#CCCCCC",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +

  # Study area
  geom_sf(
    data = poly_proj,
    fill = "#D9E8F5",
    color = "#919191ff",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  # Hexagonal comparison bins
  geom_sf(
    data = hex_order_comp,
    aes(fill = contribution_type, alpha = log_density),
    color = NA
  ) +

  # Facet across orders horizontally
  facet_wrap(vars(order), nrow = 1) +

  # Padded map limits
  coord_sf(
    xlim = xlim_padded,
    ylim = ylim_padded,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +

  # Category color scale
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "iNat Only" = "#e31a1c", # Saturated bright red
      "iNat Higher" = "#ff7f00", # Warm amber / bright orange
      "Equal Density" = "#252525", # Charcoal black (stands out through alpha) 737373
      "GBIF Higher" = "#33a02c", # Vivid grass green
      "GBIF Only" = "#1f78b4" # Bold royal blue
    ),
    name = "Dataset Contribution",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  # Continuous scale for Observation Density
  scale_alpha_continuous(
    range = c(0.35, 1.0),
    name = "Total Density\n(Observations)",
    breaks = log10(c(1, 10, 100, 1000)),
    labels = c("1", "10", "100", "1,000+")
  ) +

  # Ensure legend keys remain distinct
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1), order = 1),
    alpha = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "#818181ff"), order = 2)
  ) +

  labs(
    #title = "iNaturalist Observations Relative to GBIF Occurrences by Aquatic Insect Order",
    title = NULL,
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "#D0D0D0",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#C6E2FF", color = NA), # Matching water tone
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "#333333", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#EBEBEB", color = "#CCCCCC"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "#C0C0C0"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )
```
